headline: Emerson Acquires Glue Inc. to Accelerate AI-Driven Test & Measurement Innovation
summary: Global automation leader Emerson (NYSE: EMR) today announced it has acquired Glue Inc., an innovator in advancing intelligent validation and test through its AI-enabled software product Glue Studio. Glue Studio features specialized AI-centric capabilities for test generation and planning. The acquisition strengthens Emerson's strategy to deliver more software-defined, data-centric capabilities across Test & Measurement's NI portfolio.
